# walk_user_tool

> Walk the user through a MULTI-STEP task with guided on-screen callouts.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `ui` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=walk_user_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Walk the user through a MULTI-STEP task with guided on-screen callouts.
Use this whenever the user asks to be walked through something, asks HOW
to do something ("walk me through…", "how do I…", "teach me to…"), or
asks for a TOUR / to be SHOWN AROUND / to EXPLORE an area ("show me
around Chat", "give me a tour", "explore the apps"). For any such ask,
try this tool FIRST — before navigate_user_tool (which only changes
pages, with no guidance) and before answering from documentation: a
guided walkthrough on the user's real screen beats a text overview.
Call it AT MOST ONCE per request, with the user's own words; it
resolves them against the app's walkthrough catalog. A "queued" result
means SUCCESS — the walkthrough runs when your reply is delivered, so
finish your reply; never re-call to check or retry. If the tool reports
the task is not in the catalog, tell the user plainly that you don't
have a walkthrough for that yet — NEVER claim a walkthrough you did not
queue, and never improvise step lists in text as a substitute; only
after a reported miss should you fall back to other tools or a text
answer. For pointing out a SINGLE element, use show_user_tool instead.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task` | string | yes | The task the user wants to be walked through, in their words (e.g. 'starring a project'). |
